dependency_environments.capture_method: python -m pip list --format=json from exact measured environments

normalization.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON array with sorted object keys, compact separators, and no trailing newline
normalization.name_rule: PEP 503 lowercase with each run of hyphen, underscore, or period replaced by one hyphen

environment.cpu: 11th Gen Intel Core i5-11400H at 2.70 GHz
environment.python_executable_category: matched external disposable virtual environments created from the installed Python 3.13 launcher

instrumentation.integrity_timing_note: format-2 does not expose standalone before/after manifest duration; reported non-analysis batch overhead also contains process startup, persistence, comparison, and Handoff work
instrumentation.total_timing: external CLI process wall time per supported two-scan batch
instrumentation.tracemalloc: enabled for every historical and current analysis repetition

regression_confidence: No comparable Python 3.13 product regression was confirmed.

regression_policy.comparison_rounding: Round medians to three decimals; subtract rounded medians and round to three decimals; divide the rounded absolute difference by the rounded historical median, multiply by 100, and round to three decimals.
regression_policy.decision_description: Percentage regression applies only to directly comparable byte-identical subjects on the same host and Python patch with consistent instrumentation and evidence-count parity. A subject reaches the primary threshold when its current median is at least 25% slower; confirmation requires at least two comparable subjects unless one isolated product phase supports the documented exception. Zscripts is not percentage-compared because its repository trees differ. No current directly comparable subject reaches the threshold.

contamination_reasons: unrelated Rust compilation began during round-1 current public-medium
unrelated Rust compilation active at round-3 historical zscripts-public completion
repetition_design.contract_mismatch: Both harnesses require repeat 2..5, so alternation occurred between supported two-scan batches rather than between individual internal scans.

subjects.comparability_reason: exact historical and current repository trees differ; repository growth is reported without a percentage regression
subjects.label: zscripts-public
